summary.en: Liquidity is expanding. Fed balance sheet expanded +$19.0B WoW. TGA has released $168B from its $1.007T peak, down to $838.6B (-$24.2B WoW). Net liquidity has recovered +$177B from the April 22 bottom of $5,700B. Bank reserves are back above $3T at $3.117T. However, Warsh took office on 5/15 with explicit intentions for significant QT — June FOMC is the watershed moment.
summary.zh: 流动性正在扩张。美联储资产负债表周环比扩张 +$19.0B。TGA 从 $1.007T 峰值已释放 $168B，降至 $838.6B（周环比 -$24.2B）。净流动性从 4/22 底部 $5,700B 回升 +$177B。银行准备金重返 $3T 以上，达到 $3.117T。然而，Warsh 于 5/15 上任，明确表示要大幅缩表——6 月 FOMC 是分水岭。

tga_note.zh: 周环比 -$24.2B——从 $1.007T 峰值已释放 $168B

details.en: Liquidity metrics remain positive in the short term. The TGA continues to release funds, and the Fed balance sheet is expanding. Bank reserves have returned above $3.1T. However, Warsh's QT intentions represent the most significant medium-term risk. The June FOMC will be the decisive moment — if QT is announced, the liquidity formula reverses fundamentally.
details.zh: 短期内流动性指标仍然积极。TGA 持续释放资金，美联储资产负债表在扩张。银行准备金已重返 $3.1T 以上。然而，Warsh 的缩表意图是最重大的中期风险。6 月 FOMC 将是决定性时刻——如果宣布缩表，流动性公式将根本性反转。

reason.en: Fed expanding +$19B, TGA released $168B, bank reserves at $3.1T+. However, Warsh's QT threat discounts the score. June FOMC is the watershed.

reason.zh: 仅 52.48% 在 200 日均线上方且在下降。金融 -5% YTD，医疗 0%。市场由科技和能源两板块撑着。过去 3 天蒸发 $1.2T 市值。这是最大的警告信号。

trading_summary.en: 62.1 — Moderate-High. Liquidity expanding (+$177B from April bottom), earnings accelerating (Q1 +27.7%, strongest in 5 years) — these are the reasons to stay long. But breadth at 52% says this isn't a broad bull market, oil at $111 says inflation is back, BTC -40% says risk-off, Gold ATH says the world is unsafe. 62% position, concentrated in AI/semis and energy. Wait for June FOMC and breadth confirmation. Cut to 50% if breadth breaks below 48%, cut to 40% immediately if Warsh announces QT.
trading_summary.zh: 62.1分，Moderate-High。流动性在扩张（从4月底部回升$177B），盈利在加速（Q1 +27.7%五年最强）——这是做多的理由。但广度52%在说这不是全面牛市，油价$111在说通胀回来了，BTC -40%在说risk-off，Gold ATH在说世界不安全。62%仓位，集中在AI/半导体和能源。等6月FOMC和广度确认。广度跌破48%减仓到50%，Warsh宣布缩表立即降到40%。

trading_quote: Earnings say 'buy', breadth says 'be careful', oil says 'inflation is back'. Wait for June FOMC.

note.en: Rising — fear increasing at market highs

exchange_flow_detail.en: $661M liquidated overnight. Down 40% from $126K all-time high. Crypto saying risk-off while equities near ATH.
exchange_flow_detail.zh: $661M 一夜清算。从 $126K 历史高点下跌 40%。加密在说 risk-off，而股市接近历史新高。

analysis.en: BTC at ~$76,000, down 40% from its $126K all-time high with $661M liquidated overnight. The BTC-equity divergence is the clearest risk-off signal in the market. Historically, this type of divergence resolves with equities moving toward crypto (risk-off) rather than crypto catching up.
analysis.zh: BTC 约 $76,000，从 $126K 历史高点下跌 40%，一夜清算 $661M。BTC 与股市的背离是市场中最清晰的风险规避信号。历史上，这种背离通常以股市向加密靠拢（风险规避）而非加密追赶股市来解决。

analysis.en: Gold at $4,492/oz, near all-time highs. Silver $74.50 (-0.88%), Copper $103.91 (-0.23%). Gold near ATH while equities also near ATH is a historically unusual and contradictory signal — the market is simultaneously pricing in growth (equities) and fear (gold). Historically, this resolves with equities moving toward gold (lower), not gold moving toward equities.
analysis.zh: 黄金报 $4,492/盎司，接近历史高点。白银 $74.50（-0.88%），铜 $103.91（-0.23%）。黄金接近历史新高而股市也接近历史新高，这是历史上罕见且矛盾的信号——市场同时在定价增长（股市）和恐惧（黄金）。历史上，这通常以股市向黄金靠拢（下跌）而非黄金向股市靠拢来解决。

detail.en: S&P is near ATH but only 52% of stocks are above their 200DMA, and that number is falling. $1.2T in market cap evaporated over the past 3 days. Financials are -5% YTD, Healthcare is flat. A narrow market driven by a few sectors is fragile at these heights.
detail.zh: S&P 在 ATH 附近但仅 52% 在 200 日均线上方且在下降，过去 3 天蒸发 $1.2T 市值。金融 -5% YTD，医疗 0%。少数股票驱动的市场，根基不够宽。

detail.en: WTI at $110.92 is the highest since 2022, meaning inflation will not subside and the Fed will not cut rates. Warsh took office on 5/15 with explicit plans for QT. If the June FOMC shifts from expansion to contraction, the liquidity formula reverses fundamentally.
detail.zh: WTI $110.92 是 2022 年以来最高，通胀不会消退，Fed 不会降息。Warsh 5/15 上任明确要缩表，6 月 FOMC 如果从扩表转缩表，流动性公式根本性反转。

detail.en: BTC dropped from $126K to $76K with $661M liquidated overnight — crypto is saying risk-off. Gold at $4,492 near ATH while equities are also near ATH is a contradictory signal. Historically, this resolves with equities moving toward gold (lower).
detail.zh: BTC 从 $126K 跌至 $76K，$661M 一夜清算，加密在说 risk-off。Gold $4,492 创新高 + 股市 ATH 矛盾共存，历史上通常以股市向黄金靠拢结束。

title.en: Active. S&P ATH + breadth 52% (divergence). Equities ATH + BTC -40% (divergence). Equities ATH + Gold ATH (contradiction). VIX rising + index at highs (warning).
title.zh: 活跃。S&P ATH + 广度 52%（背离）。股市 ATH + BTC -40%（背离）。股市 ATH + Gold ATH（矛盾）。VIX 上升 + 指数高位（预警）。

detail.en: Multiple divergences are active simultaneously. S&P is near ATH but breadth is only 52% and falling. Equities near ATH while BTC is down 40%. Equities and Gold both near ATH — historically contradictory. VIX rising while the index is at highs. These signals collectively suggest the market is fragile despite headline strength.
detail.zh: 多个背离同时活跃。S&P 接近 ATH 但广度仅 52% 且在下降。股市接近 ATH 而 BTC 跌 40%。股市和黄金同时接近历史新高——历史上矛盾信号。VIX 在指数高位时上升。这些信号共同表明，尽管表面强劲，市场实际上很脆弱。
